Pasture Friends Rules

Collect all five farm animals on your pasture. A die tells you which animal you may take.

The rules

The goal
Every player has a pasture with five places: cow, sheep, pig, hen and horse. Whoever has all five animals on the pasture first wins. The game has 35 cards, seven of each animal, and five of them lie open in the middle: the yard.
Your turn
Roll the die. It shows one of the five animals. If the yard has a card of that animal and your pasture does not have the animal yet, the card moves to your pasture, and a new card from the pile is turned up in its place. Then the next player rolls.
The farmer
The sixth side of the die shows the farmer. He helps you: tap any card in the yard of an animal you still miss, and it moves to your pasture.
No card for you
If the yard has no card of the rolled animal, or you have the animal already, you send one yard card of your choice back under the pile. A new card is turned up. Think about which card you do not need - and which one the others do.
The end
The game ends at once when one pasture is full. With two to four players a game takes about five minutes. There is no time limit, and nothing has to be read: every card, die side and place shows a picture.

Example

You miss the pig and the hen. You roll the pig and the yard shows a pig: take it. Next turn you roll the horse, which you have already: send a card you do not need back, so that the hen may turn up.
